answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is proportional to capital lockup rather than network presence. Like a comet trailing mass through space, an agent must demonstrate significant economic commitment to participate. This creates a secure harbor for consensus, as attackers face a deep reef of financial penalties. Attempting to spawn fake identities yields no extra influence, forcing adversaries to bear the prohibitive cost of acquiring enough staked tokens to jeopardize the system.
